name: EPITA - School of Engineering and Computer Science
description: The École Pour l'Informatique et les Techniques Avancées (EPITA School of Engineering and Computer Science), better known as EPITA, a private French grande école with a focus on computer science and software engineering was founded in 1984 by Patrice Dumoucel. It is a private engineering school located in Le Kremlin-Bicêtre, south of Paris, which has been a part of the IONIS Education Group since 1994. It is also accredited by the Commission des titres d'ingénieur (CTI) to provide the French Diplôme d'Ingénieur.
